name: Title
description: Semantic heading with size and terminal (serif/sans) variants.

as.description: Override the rendered element (h1-h6); wins over level.

unstyled.description: When true, only sets the heading tag + className (no Title token typography). Use in patterns/pages that already define font/size in CSS or Tailwind.

size.description: Display size token for the heading.

level.description: Semantic heading level (maps to h1-h6 when as is unset).

flush.description: Drop the block margins. Use when the parent owns spacing: a row, a cell, a card or a flex/grid gap.
